patent_grounding.rationale: The modeled actuator, rack-and-pinion embodiment, opposite-direction force transfer, jaw/workpiece contacts, and sequential baseline-plus-added gripping force are supported by the cited claim passages. The rack embodiment is explicitly framed as the selected conceptual embodiment; alternatives remain outside the architecture.

functional_completeness.rationale: The model captures fluid input, actuator extension, baseline clamping, force-reversal contribution, cumulative increase, and workpiece contact at the stated conceptual scope. Unsupported control states and sensing are properly omitted.

flow_consistency.rationale: The previously orphaned baseline_clamping_force now connects jaw assembly output to the workpiece input through an interface referencing that flow. Its endpoints are both mechanical_force; the other interfaces likewise use compatible flow types and directions.

claim_traceability.rationale: All ID-bearing model items, including the new baseline force ports, flow, and interface, have citation entries pointing to existing patent chunks. The claims distinguish the baseline clamping force from its cumulative augmentation.

interfaces.rationale: Each interface connects existing endpoint ports with compatible types and flow references, and every connection is represented once. External source and workpiece are modeled separately rather than as a generic external entity.

textbook_application.rationale: Context/interface guidance supports explicit boundary entities and flows; it is used as modeling guidance only. Patent passages, not textbook text, support invention facts.

summary: Revision 5 resolves the prior orphan-flow concern by connecting the patent-supported baseline jaw clamping force from the jaw assembly to the workpiece. Reviewed cited patent passages directly; modeled functions, flows, interfaces, and claims are grounded and internally consistent. No unresolved issues found in this review.
